sources.title: 4.4 magnitude earthquake strikes off Oregon Coast
Wild Video Shows Plane Crash on Busy Highway

en.title: 4.4 magnitude earthquake strikes off Oregon Coast; Typhoon Cempaka monitoring
en.dek: A 4.4 magnitude earthquake struck off the Oregon Coast, and Typhoon Cempaka was being monitored.
facts: A 4.4 magnitude earthquake struck off the Oregon Coast on 2026-11-08T21:31:21.000Z
The earthquake was reported by KMTR
A plane crash on a busy highway was captured on wild video
body: A 4.4 magnitude earthquake struck off the Oregon Coast on 2026-11-08T21:31:21.000Z, according to KMTR.
The quake was reported by KMTR as striking off the Oregon Coast.
Typhoon Cempaka was being monitored, according to the event description.
Wild video showed a plane crash on a busy highway, according to The Daily Beast.
en.context: The Oregon Coast earthquake and Typhoon Cempaka monitoring occurred on 2026-11-08, alongside a plane crash on a busy highway captured on wild video.

zh.title: 4.4级地震袭击俄勒冈海岸；关注台风“詹帕卡”
zh.dek: 4.4级地震袭击俄勒冈海岸，台风“詹帕卡”正被监测
facts: A 4.4 magnitude earthquake struck off the Oregon Coast on 2026-11-08T21:31:21.000Z
The earthquake was reported by KMTR
A plane crash on a busy highway was captured on wild video
body: 俄勒冈海岸外围于2026年11月8日21时31分21秒发生4.4级地震，据KMTR报道。
KMTR报告称此次地震袭击了俄勒冈海岸。
据事件描述，正在监测台风“詹帕卡”。
据《每日野兽》报道，画面显示一架飞机在繁忙高速公路上坠毁。
zh.context: The Oregon Coast earthquake and Typhoon Cempaka monitoring occurred on 2026-11-08, alongside a plane crash on a busy highway captured on wild video

ko.title: 4.4 규모 지진이 오레곤 해안서 발생…태풍 캄파카 감시
ko.dek: 4.4 규모 지진이 오레곤 해안에서 발생했으며, 태풍 캄파카가 감시되고 있다.
facts: 2026년 11월 8일 오후 9시 31분 21초, 오레곤 해안에서 4.4 규모 지진 발생
busy highway에서 포착된 비행기 추락 영상
body: 4.4 규모 지진이 오레건 해안에서 발생했다. KMTR에 따르면 2026년 11월 8일 오후 9시 31분 21초에 일어났다.
지진은 오레건 해안에서 발생했다고 KMTR이 보도했다.
태풍 캄파카가 감시되고 있다고 사건 설명에 언급됐다.
The Daily Beast에 따르면 바쁜 고속도로에서 비행기 추락 영상이 공개됐다.
ko.context: 2026년 11월 8일, 오레곤 해안 지진과 태풍 캄파카 감시, 그리고 busy highway에서 포착된 비행기 추락 사건이 동시에 발생
